starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-withou.speaker: Burntmeat
starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-withou.text: Oh, it you again. I bin thinking 'bout you.

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-withou.player: I probably won't feel happy for knowing the answer to this, but why have you been thinking about me?

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-withou.speaker: Burntmeat
starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-withou.text: Ohhh, Burntmeat not finished thinking yet. Maybe next time you come here I tell you.
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the My Arm's Big Adventure quest.

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat.speaker: Burntmeat
starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat.text: Oh, it you again. I bin thinking 'bout you.

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat.player: I probably won't feel happy for knowing the answer to this, but why have you been thinking about me?

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat.speaker: Burntmeat
starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat.text: Well, Burntmeat need big important job doing, and you bin helpful before. You fetch Burntmeat tasty human for stew that time.

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat.prompt: Start the My Arm's Big Adventure quest?

steps.player: What do you want now?

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: You remember you come in here asking me questions about goutweed, yah?

steps.player: Yes, you told me trolls had picked it all until there wasn't any left.

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Yah. But Burntmeat is hearing where goutweed is growing again.

steps.player: Oh? How did you hear that?

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Well, I was cooking dis adventurer...
Cutscene begins.

steps.speaker: Adventurer
steps.text: You like my armour? If you let me go, I'll let you keep it!

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Nah, silly red metal just hurt troll teeth.
Burntmeat knocks aside the dragon platelegs and uncovers goutweed.

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Huh? What dis? You got goutweed here!

steps.speaker: Adventurer
steps.text: You can have that too! Just let me go!

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Only place find goutweed is my storeroom. You bin stealing?

steps.speaker: Adventurer
steps.text: No! I-I- I grew that myself!

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: What say? Goutweed not grow now. Trolls pick it all.

steps.speaker: Adventurer
steps.text: No, no; I grew it.

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Humans grow goutweed? You lying to Burntmeat!

steps.speaker: Adventurer
steps.text: You can get the gout tuber from Tai Bwo Wannai Village. Go there and ask Murcaily. Then you plant it in a farming patch.

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Mmmm. Burntmeat think that sound good. But Burntmeat cook you first.

steps.speaker: Adventurer
steps.text: Oh b...
Cutscene ends.

steps.player: You killed that poor chap! What had he ever done to you?

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Well, he give me mighty sore tummy later. I think I forget to wash his feet.

steps.player: Anyway, why did you tell me about all that?

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Ah! Der man I cooked, he say humans growing goutweed again. Now, if humans growing goutweed, maybe trolls can grow goutweed too, yah?

steps.player: You want to become a farmer?

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: No, not me. Burntmeat stick to what he best at doing. But I got me an assistant wanting to learn farming. He called My Arm.

steps.player: Your assistant's called WHAT?

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: He called My Arm.

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: My Arm.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Yep, My Arm.

steps.player: But why is he called...

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: It a perfectly good troll name.

steps.player: Alright, enough! What do you want me to do for this Arm person?

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: You gonna help My Arm grow goutweed.

steps.player: Look, you're a vicious monster who eats innocent people! Why should I ever help you again?

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: See, [player name], if My Arm learns to grow goutweed, I get as much goutweed as I ever want. If dat happens, I promise you I never cook another human in my life.

steps.player: Never?

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Never. Burntmeat promises. Goat taste just as good as human if you add enough goutweed. Now you go talk to My Arm; he tell you what to do.

steps.prompt: What would you like to say?

options.text: Can I have all that dragon stuff as my reward?

steps.player: Can I have all that dragon stuff as my reward?

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: What dragon stuff you talking 'bout?

steps.player: When you were telling me about the man you cooked who talked about goutweed, there was loads of valuable stuff on the floor. Can I have it? PLEASE!

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Sorry, Player - Burntmeat chucked dat stuff away. It no good to eat. Red metal clothes hurt troll teeth, and big whip thing get stuck in throat.
If the player has completed Swan Song:

steps.player: Gah! You're worse than the old man who wouldn't give me his hat!

steps.text: If the player has not completed Swan Song:

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: You go help My Arm now.

options.text: Alright, I'll lend him a hand.

steps.player: Alright, I'll lend him a hand. But you'd better keep that promise about not cooking any more people!
You're disgusting! I'm not helping you again.

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Aww, now you done hurt Burntmeat's feelings.

starting-off-if-the-burntmeat-cutscene-i.speaker: Burntmeat
starting-off-if-the-burntmeat-cutscene-i.text: If you not paying attention, Burntmeat not going to talk to you!

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.player: You were about to tell me about some job...

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.speaker: Burntmeat
starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.text: Yep, I remember. See, when you come here asking me 'bout goutweed dat other time, I tell you how we trolls had picked it all, and it not grow no more.

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.player: Right, you told me the only goutweed anywhere in the world was in your storage room.

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.text: Continues above from "Yah. But Burntmeat is hearing where goutweed is growing again."

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.speaker: Burntmeat
starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.text: You get on with helping My Arm, yah?

starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.player: Before I start helping you with the whole farming thing, could you just explain why you're called My Arm?

starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.text: Dat's easy! You know we trolls named after der first thing wot we try to eat when we young?

starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.player: Okay, so what did you try to eat?

starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.text: It were my dad's arm. I remember it look so big holding me, I just gotta give it a chew. So he done named me My Arm.

starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.player: And no one thinks it's a silly name?

starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.text: If My Arm has recently spoken to another player:

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Well, I seen worse. Most humans come through here, dey got names with like all numbers and things wot aren't even words! I met some [man/woman] earlier wot called [himself/herself] [other player's name].

starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.text: If My Arm has not recently spoken to another player:

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Well, I seen worse. Most humans come through here, dey got names with like all numbers and things wot aren't even words!

starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.text: If you happy 'bout my name now, I tell you 'bout dis farming job.

starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.player: Alright, My Arm (snicker snicker), tell me about it.

starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.text: Okieday. Now, I heard 'bout dese gouty thingies before. Da cooks up on Death Plateau were saying dey cooked a man wot had a lump in his pocket dat tasted like goutweed, but wasn't goutweed.

starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.text: My Arm is thinking this is da thingy we need.

starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.player: So what do we do about it?

starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.text: You go to Death Plateau and search da big cooking pot for da goutweedy lump!
If the player has a gout tuber:

steps.player: There's no need for that. I already have a tuber. Do you want to see it?

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Just do as I say, yah?

steps.player: But there's no point in worrying about some weird lump on Death Plateau when I've got a tuber.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: I not want to see your tuber! My Arm is organised troll who gets one thing done at a time. I need da goutweedy lump from da cooking pot on Death Plateau.

steps.player: Hmph.

starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.text: If the player doesn't have a gout tuber:

steps.player: Why do I need to go there? Can't I just get you a proper gout tuber?

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Never mind tubers. You fetch me da goutweedy lump from da cooking pot of Dung 'n' Ash on Death Plateau.

steps.player: Hmph.

starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-talking-to-my-arm.text: Go see Burntmeat - he give good directions for getting there.

starting-off-talking-to-my-arm-again.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-talking-to-my-arm-again.text: You got da goutweedy lump yet?

starting-off-talking-to-my-arm-again.prompt: What would you like to say?

steps.player: No, not yet.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: You go getting yourself a move on, yah? My Arm getting bored. Ask Burntmeat if you needin' help findin' da place.

steps.player: What was it you wanted?

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: You is a bit forgetful. If you like, My Arm give you nice tap on head to clear out cobbiewebs from brain.

steps.player: No! Just tell me what it was you wanted.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Okieday, maybe some other time. Now, what you gotta do is go to Death Plateau and fetch me da goutweedy lump from da big cooking pot.

steps.player: Oh yes, how could I forget?

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Perhaps you is a bit thick in da head. Ask Burntmeat if you needin' help findin' da place.

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.speaker: Burntmeat
starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.text: How you an' My Arm getting on with da goutweed?

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.player: He wants me to fetch something from a cauldron on Death Plateau.

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.speaker: Burntmeat
starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.text: Death Plateau, huh? Dat's quite a long way. Do you know how to get dere?

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.prompt: What would you like to say?

options.text: I am a navigational genius; I'll be fine.

steps.player: I am a navigational genius; I'll be fine.

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Okieday. Just you mind out for dem troll cooks on Death Plateau - dey not as friendly as Burntmeat.

options.text: This place is a maze - got any advice?

steps.player: This place is a maze - got any advice?

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Okieday, listen up an' Burntmeat tell you da best way to Death Plateau...
Cutscene begins.

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: You go out da north door of my kitchen an' walk all da way down da corridor.

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Turn right at da end, and go down da stairs to da prison where we keep meat fresh.

steps.player: A prison where you keep meat fresh?

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Yup. Can't keep people in crates like goutweed, dey go all dead an' smelly. Burntmeat tried it.

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Walk straight through da prison. Da back door of da Stronghold is at da south end.

steps.player: Okay, so I've gone northwards up the corridor, down the stairs, then southwards through the prison.

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Dat is correct. Now you gettin' outside...

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: When you outside, you turn left an' go long way south-east along path.
If the player has climbing boots:

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: At the end, you gotta turn left for Death Plateau. You got da special boots, so you gonna be okay on da rocks there.
If the player doesn't have climbing boots:

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: At the end, you gotta turn left for Death Plateau. But watch out for da tricky rocks - maybe you gonna have trouble climbing dem.

steps.player: How do I get to Death Plateau if I can't climb the rocks?

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Burntmeat heard where da humans going on Death Plateau wear funny boots to help climb rocks. Dey get da boots from little dwarf woman wot lives near da plateau. Turn right to go to her house.
Cutscene ends

steps.player: Thanks, you've been remarkably helpful, considering that you're a horrible monster who eats innocent people.

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Aww! You hurry up an' get My Arm what he wanting.

starting-off-obtaining-the-goutweedy-lum.text: You dip the bucket into the pot...

starting-off-attempting-to-scoop-from-th.text: You dip the bucket into the pot...

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.speaker: Burntmeat
starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.text: How you an' My Arm getting on with da goutweed?

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.player: So far he's had me go to Death Plateau to fetch a weird lump from the cauldron there.

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.speaker: Burntmeat
starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.text: Da cooks on da plateau not as good as Burntmeat.

starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.text: You got da goutweedy lump yet?

starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.player: Yes, I have it. Here, take the thing.

starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.text: Huh. It looking a bit tatty...
My Arm has eaten the goutweedy lump.

starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.text: Yep, it tasting like goutweed too.

starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.player: So what are you going to do now?

starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.text: Well, now My Arm know dese goutweedy lump things exist, you help me grow one, yah?

starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.player: Alright. Where do you need me to start?

starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.text: My Arm done tried farming before. I stick all kindsa things in da ground, but nothing ever grow, not even when I water 'em.

starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.text: I bin planting everythin', [player name]. Sticks, rocks, dead goats... you name it.

starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.player: And none of those things grew?

starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.text: Nope, not even a smidgen. My Arm dug 'em up again to see.

starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.player: So did you try getting help from someone who knows about farming?

starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.text: Yah, My Arm found a nice farmer and ate him, but he not help much. He taste kinda boring too.

starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.player: You're not very clever, are you?

starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.text: My ol' mum say I clever enough. What you getting at?

starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.player: Oh, nothing. Maybe I should see where you've been doing all this farming?

starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-giving-the-goutweedy-lump-t.text: Sure t'ing, Player. I show you...
My Arm leads you through the Troll Stronghold...

starting-off-interrupting-the-dialogue-a.speaker: My Arm
starting-off-interrupting-the-dialogue-a.text: You done good fetching dat goutweedy lump. My Arm very impressed.
Continues from "So what are you going to do now?" above.

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.speaker: Burntmeat
starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.text: How you an' My Arm getting on with da goutweed?

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.player: So far he's had me fetch some kind of lump from a pot on Death Plateau. I can't imagine what he'll want next.

starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.speaker: Burntmeat
starting-off-talking-to-burntmeat-after-.text: Huh... Let me know when we got goutweed growing.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-on-the-roof.speaker: My Arm
fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-on-the-roof.text: Dis is my quiet place. No other trolls come up here. It where I bin trying to grow stuff.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-on-the-roof.player: It's a bit windy up here.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-on-the-roof.text: If the player has Ugthanki dung:

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Dat is good, cos you smellin' distinctly whiffy. It like you got all dung in your pockets or something. Or maybe you needing a wash.

steps.player: I wash more than enough!

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Okieday, maybe My Arm imagining da smell.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-on-the-roof.text: If the player doesn't have Ugthanki dung:

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Yup, but My Arm not mind. We trolls not get blown around by wind like diddy little humans.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-on-the-roof.player: So you think you could grow things here?

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-on-the-roof.speaker: My Arm
fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-on-the-roof.text: I t'ink so, yah. I got book 'bout farming for you to read.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-on-the-roof.player: Where in the world did YOU get a book?

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-on-the-roof.speaker: My Arm
fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-on-the-roof.text: Dat farmer I ate had a book with him. My Arm is hopin' you knows how to read.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-on-the-roof.speaker: My Arm
fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-on-the-roof.text: My Arm not know what in book, so you read it, yuh? Perhaps it tell you how to grow t'ings up on mountain.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-on-the-roof.player: Alright, I'll have a look inside.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-again-befor.speaker: My Arm
fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-again-befor.text: You know how to read book I got off farmer?

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-again-befor.player: Of course I can read it! Just give me a moment.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-again-befor.speaker: My Arm
fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-again-befor.text: If you forget how to read, it not a problem. My Arm give you little tap on head and maybe you remember again, no trouble.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-again-befor.player: No thanks, that won't be necessary.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-after-losin.text: Continues from "Dat farmer I ate had a book with him."

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-again-after.speaker: My Arm
fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-again-after.text: You know how to read book I got off farmer?

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-again-after.player: Of course; I've been reading it.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-again-after.speaker: My Arm
fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-again-after.text: Dat's good. Is it any use?

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-again-after.player: There's a useful section about preparing soil for growing crops. For a mountain area, it says we need to mix three buckets of camel dung and seven buckets of supercompost into the soil.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-again-after.speaker: My Arm
fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-again-after.text: Urgh. Dat's a lotta camel dung.
If the player has 3 ugthanki dung:

steps.player: Fortunately, I've got enough dung with me.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: My Arm not like to say so earlier, but you bin smellin' like you done a whoopsie.

steps.player: Thanks a lot!

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-again-after.text: If the player doesn't have 3 ugthanki dung:

steps.player: Have you any dung in the Stronghold I could use?

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Why you think trolls keep dung in Stronghold? Do you keep dung in your house?

steps.player: It was worth a try.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: You could go ask a camel for some dung. I bet dey got plenty.

steps.player: Ask a camel for dung?

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Best way to get somefing: find someone who got plenty of it wot they don't want.
If the player is wearing a camulet:

steps.player: How handy - I've got an amulet that lets me talk to camels.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Clever human. Off you go now.
If the player has a camulet in their inventory:

steps.player: How handy - I'm already carrying my Camulet.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Clever human. Off you go now.
If the player has a camulet in the bank:

steps.player: Okay, I guess it's time for me to dig that old Camulet out of the bank.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: That could help. Off you go now.
If the player has completed Enakhra's Lament and doesn't have their camulet:

steps.player: If only I still had that Camulet I got in that weird temple in the desert...

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Wot a shame; off you go now.
If the player has not completed Enakhra's Lament:

steps.player: Of course, it'd be silly for me to ask a camel. I can't talk to camels. But I do remember getting some camel dung before, in some desert town once...

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: My Arm is sure you'll find some way to get dung out of a camel. Now trot along.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-after-being.speaker: My Arm
fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-after-being.text: You put all dat dung and stuff in da soil yet?

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-after-being.player: No, not yet. I'm working on it.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-after-being.speaker: My Arm
fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-after-being.text: You be getting move on, [player name].

fertiliser-preparing-the-patch-using-sup.player: I need a spade to dig the supercompost in properly.

fertiliser-preparing-the-patch-using-ugt.player: I'm not mixing dung into the soil with my hands! I need a spade to dig it in properly.

fertiliser-preparing-the-patch-using-nor.player: Unfortunately the book definitely said SUPERcompost.

fertiliser-preparing-the-patch-using-an-.player: I don't think that's going to help just now.

fertiliser-preparing-the-patch-adding-mo.player: I don't think it'll need any more supercompost.
I think I've given it enough dung already.

fertiliser-preparing-the-patch-using-an-.player: My Arm can tend the patch himself. I'm not growing the goutweed for him.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-after-treat.player: I've finished treating that soil patch for you.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-after-treat.speaker: My Arm
fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-after-treat.text: Good, good. Always I bin wanting a farming patch to grow things in. Da soggy bits south of here, they not work at all.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-after-treat.player: So what do we need to do now?

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-after-treat.speaker: My Arm
fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-after-treat.text: Now we do like dat man say to Burntmeat. We gotta go to Tai Bwo Wannai Village and see Murcaily 'bout growing goutweed.
If the player has a gout tuber:

steps.player: We don't need to go there. I've got a gout tuber.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: I not wanna be gettin' confused with your tuber. Man tell Burntmeat we need to go see Murcaily to grow goutweed, so dat where we going.

steps.player: You really need to be more flexible.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Trolls not flexible creatures. Humans too flexible; dey got little necks wot snap easy as anything.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-after-treat.player: It's a long way to Tai Bwo Wannai Village. We're going to need a boat...

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-after-treat.text: Screen fades, player and My Arm appear at Ardougne docks.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-after-treat.speaker: Captain Barnaby
fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-after-treat.text: What in the world is that THING?

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-after-treat.prompt: What would you like to say?

options.text: That is My Arm. We'd like to go to Karamja.

steps.player: That is My Arm. We'd like to go to Karamja.

steps.speaker: Captain Barnaby
steps.text: This is your what?

steps.player: He's a troll. His name is My Arm.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Yup, My Arm.

steps.speaker: Captain Barnaby
steps.text: Whose arm?

steps.player: Never mind that now, we just want to go to Karamja. Can you take us?

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: It was my dad's arm.

steps.speaker: Captain Barnaby
steps.text: What about your dad's arm?

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: My Arm tried to eat it.

steps.speaker: Captain Barnaby
steps.text: Your arm did what?

steps.player: Will you take us to Karamja?

steps.speaker: Captain Barnaby
steps.text: I don't think I want the mad troll.

steps.speaker: Captain Barnaby
steps.text: Or his arm.

steps.player: Either you can take us to Karamja, or you can discuss it with My Arm.

steps.speaker: Captain Barnaby
steps.text: Oh no, not your arm too...

steps.player: So you'll take us?

steps.speaker: Captain Barnaby
steps.text: Alright, just get the arm thing onto the ship.
Cutscene begins.
My Arm is thinking...

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Urrrgh!

steps.player: What?

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: My Arm not liking dis.

steps.player: What's wrong with your ar... What's wrong with you?

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: You ever hear stories of troll sailors or troll pirates?

steps.player: Um... can't think of any just now.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Dat 'cos trolls don't like da sea. We kinda sink.
If the player has started Swan Song:

steps.player: I'm sure I've met some trolls that lived in the sea. There's a Fishing Colony up in the north-west.

steps.text: If the player has not started Swan Song:

steps.player: Aren't there... river trolls and sea trolls and things? They seem happy enough in the sea.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Them not proper trolls. Proper trolls live in mountains.

steps.player: But they look just like land trolls!

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: We trolls. Them not trolls. 'Nuff said.

steps.player: Oh, please yourself!

steps.text: My Arm is thinking...

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Are we dere yet?

steps.player: No! Look - no land.

steps.text: My Arm is thinking...

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: How 'bout now?

steps.player: Still. No. Land.

steps.text: My Arm is thinking...

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: You gettin' angry with My Arm, huh?

steps.player: No, no.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Is it 'cos I is thick?

steps.player: I'm not angry with you.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Oh, right.
My Arm is thinking...

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Are we dere now?
Cutscene ends.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Urrrgh! My Arm feeling sick...

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: We will meet at dat village, yah?

steps.player: What?
Oh, he's gone. I hope he knows the way to Tai Bwo Wannai Village.

options.text: I'd like to go to Rimmington.
I think I'll come back another time.

steps.player: I think I'll come back another time.

steps.speaker: Captain Barnaby
steps.text: But... that thing?

steps.player: Oh, he'll be fine just standing here.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-at-ardougne.player: I have to ask Captain Barnaby to let us onto his ship.

fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-at-ardougne.speaker: My Arm
fertiliser-talking-to-my-arm-at-ardougne.text: Okieday, My Arm gonna let you do the talking. He not seem to like me standin' here.

karamja-talking-to-my-arm-outside-tai-bw.speaker: My Arm
karamja-talking-to-my-arm-outside-tai-bw.text: So dis is Tai Bwo Wannai Village, huh?

karamja-talking-to-my-arm-outside-tai-bw.player: Yes, that's right. I've been here before when the villagers thought their village was cursed. I had to fetch some special herbs for their shaman.

karamja-talking-to-my-arm-outside-tai-bw.speaker: My Arm
karamja-talking-to-my-arm-outside-tai-bw.text: You doin' a lot of favours for people. Is dere anything in it for you?

karamja-talking-to-my-arm-outside-tai-bw.player: I usually get something. Except that time when Burntmeat made me fetch him a 'tasty human' for his stew. All he gave me was some burnt meat.
Believe it or not, I didn't like it at all.

karamja-talking-to-my-arm-outside-tai-bw.speaker: My Arm
karamja-talking-to-my-arm-outside-tai-bw.text: Dat a pity. He planning to give you more burnt meat when you done helpin' me. Maybe My Arm think of something better for you. But first you go find Murcaily - he gotta help us grow goutweed.

karamja-talking-to-my-arm-again.speaker: My Arm
karamja-talking-to-my-arm-again.text: You done spoken to Murcaily 'bout goutweed yet?

karamja-talking-to-my-arm-again.speaker: My Arm
karamja-talking-to-my-arm-again.text: You slow. My Arm gettin' bored.

karamja-talking-to-murcaily-before-talki.speaker: Murcaily
karamja-talking-to-murcaily-before-talki.text: Is there anything I can do for you, Bwana?

karamja-talking-to-murcaily-before-talki.player: Have you seen My Arm around here?

karamja-talking-to-murcaily-before-talki.speaker: Murcaily
karamja-talking-to-murcaily-before-talki.text: Umm... Bwana... I can see both of them. They are attached to your shoulders, yes?

karamja-talking-to-murcaily-before-talki.player: What? Oh, forget I said that! Have you seen a troll around here?

karamja-talking-to-murcaily-before-talki.speaker: Murcaily
karamja-talking-to-murcaily-before-talki.text: I do not know what one of those is, Bwana, but I am sure there are none in our village.

karamja-talking-to-murcaily-before-talki.player: Dratted creature - where can he be? He was meant to be coming here.

karamja-talking-to-murcaily-before-talki.speaker: Murcaily
karamja-talking-to-murcaily-before-talki.text: Well, Bwana, when I am looking for someone, I find it helps to think about where they may be. If your friend was travelling this way, he is surely between here and the place where you last saw him.

karamja-talking-to-murcaily-before-talki.player: Let's see... I saw him in Brimhaven, but he ran off. He was coming this way to your village.

karamja-talking-to-murcaily-before-talki.speaker: Murcaily
karamja-talking-to-murcaily-before-talki.text: Then perhaps you should look for your friend along the route to Brimhaven.

karamja-talking-to-murcaily-after-talkin.speaker: Murcaily
karamja-talking-to-murcaily-after-talkin.text: Is there anything I can do for you, Bwana?

karamja-talking-to-murcaily-after-talkin.prompt: What would you like to say?

options.text: A troll called My Arm wants a favour...

steps.player: A troll called My Arm wants a favour from you. He wants to grow goutweed and he thinks you can help.

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: What's a troll? And what was that about your arm, Bwana?

steps.player: I really don't want to discuss it. Can you help this creature grow goutweed?

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: Goutweed? People grow it in farming patches all the time. Have you tried planting a gout tuber in your patch?

steps.player: No, the silly troll won't listen. He had me bring him all the way down from the mountains to ask you about it.

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: You want to grow it in the mountains, Bwana? That might be more difficult. Gout tubers only grow well in warm places with plenty of sun.

steps.player: You mean we aren't going to be able to grow it in the mountains?

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: No, not with a normal gout tuber. Those just won't survive the conditions. You'll need a special hardy gout tuber.

steps.player: Oh, wonderful. Can you give me some of those, please?

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: Oh no, Bwana. Those are far too valuable to give away.

steps.player: You owe me a bit of favour for the work I've been doing around the village. Are you sure you can't let me have some hardy gout tubers for the troll?

steps.text: If the player has enough favour:

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: Oh, I suppose I could let you have one. But only because you've got over sixty percent favour. If we didn't owe you so much for your help, I'd not be giving out hardy gout tubers.

steps.player: So this hardy tuber will grow like any other herb seed?

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: It grows much faster than any other I have seen, Bwana. But remember, although it is hardy enough to grow in the cold mountain lands, it may still become diseased.
If the player's inventory is full:

steps.player: Hang on. I can't hold any more stuff just now. I'll get back to you in a minute.

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: You are wise, Bwana. I have seen many an adventurer accidentally drop valuable items on the floor through trying to hold too many things.
If the player's inventory isn't full:
Murcaily has given you a hardy gout tuber.
Cutscene begins.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: My Arm bored...
Fade to Murcaily and the player.
Da Rumble in da Jungle!

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: What is this noise?
Fade to My Arm hitting a medium jungle.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Where's da goutweed?
Qutiedoll approaches My Arm.

steps.speaker: Qutiedoll
steps.text: Agh - a troll!
My Arm hits the medium jungle again.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Want goutweed!

steps.speaker: Qutiedoll
steps.text: Eek!
Qutiedoll runs away. Murcaily approaches My Arm.

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: Hey!

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: What are you doing?

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: My Arm want goutweed!

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: Be careful!
A broodoo victim appears.

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: A broodoo man!
Murcaily runs away.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Has you got goutweed?
The broodoo victim attacks My Arm.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Ow!

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Grrr!
My Arm punches the broodoo victim away.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Still want goutweed!
My Arm starts hitting another medium jungle. Murcaily returns with Jagdakobo.

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: Jagdakobo - here is the monster!

steps.speaker: Jagdakobo
steps.text: Prepare to die!

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Where you keep goutweed?
Jagdakobo attacks My Arm.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Ow!
Jagdakobo and My Arm fight.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: You got issues!
My Arm punches Jagdakobo away.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Humans all mental.
Cut to Murcaily and the player. Murcaily cries.

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: Make it go away!

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: I'll give you anything!

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: My Arm want goutweed!

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: Okay, here you go.
Murcaily walks to the player.
Murcaily has given you lots more hardy gout tubers.
Cutscene ends.

steps.player: What the heck was all THAT about?

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: You take far too long chattin' with Murcaily. My Arm come in to hurry things up.

steps.player: You could have really damaged their village!

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Silly humans got such flimsy homes. One good thump an' der walls come down.

steps.player: If you ever come to [location of player-owned house], I'm not letting you into my house.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Anyway, you got da goutweedy stuff, right?
If the player has the hardy gout tubers:

steps.player: Yes, I've got plenty of hardy gout tubers.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Right. Let's get back to da ship an' go back to Ardougne. My Arm fink you need to go to da bank.

steps.player: What do you think I need from the bank?

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: See, [player name], My Arm done tried planting stuff before, an' da birds around Trollheim Mountain, dey got... interested.

steps.player: The birds got interested in watching your farm?

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Yuh, an' dere was a great BIG one wot started trying to eat whatever I planted.

steps.player: Exactly how BIG was this bird?

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: It pretty BIG. You might wanna get some food an' stuff.

steps.player: Are we talking bigger than... a pigeon?

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: How 'bout we just go back to Ardougne so you can get your fightin' stuff...
Cutscene begins.
My Arm is thinking...

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Dat captain didn't look very happy to see us again.

steps.player: No, he wasn't.

steps.text: My Arm is thinking...

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: What was dat you said to him?

steps.player: I told him he'd better take us back, or else...

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Or else what?

steps.player: Or else I'd let my arm loose on him.

steps.text: My Arm is thinking...

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: So... are we dere yet?
Ardougne has never seemed so far away...
Cutscene ends.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: You probably wanna go to bank now to fetch yer fightin' stuff. When you finished, go back to da Troll Stronghold. My Arm gonna be waitin' by our farming patch on da roof.

steps.player: How are you going to get back to the Troll Stronghold?

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Dat not your problem.

steps.player: Alright, I'll see you there.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have the hardy gout tubers:

steps.player: Actually, I seem to have thrown it away.

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: You is dumber than a spotted kebbit! Go back an' ask Murcaily for some more!
If the player doesn't have enough favour:

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: Oh, I hadn't thought of that...

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: No, Bwana, I'm very sorry, but you'll need to do a bit more work for us before we'll be able to spare you any hardy gout tubers.

steps.player: Roughly how much more favour do I need?

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: Let me see... I think if you get it up to 60 percent, I'd be able to let you have a hardy gout tuber for your friend.

steps.player: I don't suppose you'd accept trading sticks instead?

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: Sorry, Bwana, but I don't need those. I get plenty of trading sticks from all the people wanting to use my hardwood grove. Hardy gout tubers are too precious to be bought like that.

options.text: Is there anything interesting to do around here?

karamja-talking-to-murcaily-again-after-.player: I was asking you about hardy goutweed...

karamja-talking-to-murcaily-again-after-.text: If the player doesn't have enough favour:

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: Yes, Bwana, I remember. You wanted a hardy gout tuber so your friend could grow goutweed on his mountain. But you only have [0-59] percent favour in our village. Come back to me with at least 60 percent favour and I will let you have what you need.

steps.player: Fair enough.

karamja-talking-to-murcaily-again-after-.text: If the player has enough favour:

steps.speaker: Murcaily
steps.text: Yes, Bwana, I remember. We owe you big-time for the work you done in Tai Bwo Wannai Village, so I can let you have a hardy gout tuber for your friend to grow on his mountain.
Continues from "So this hardy tuber will grow like any other herb seed?" above.

the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-at-the-patch.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-at-the-patch.text: It mean somefing like 'Home sweet home' in some old language. My Arm is well ed-oo-cated troll, not some no-brain rockhead.

the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-at-the-patch.player: Riiight. Shall we get on with growing the goutweed now?

the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-at-the-patch.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-at-the-patch.text: Yup, dat sound good. You show me how to do dat.

the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-at-the-patch.player: Ok, I'll hand you what you need, and you can use it on the patch.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-tal.player: Well, you've got a nice crop of weeds.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-tal.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-tal.text: I not go to all dis trouble to grow weedies! You supposed to help me grow goutweed!

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-tal.player: Yeah, yeah, we'll get to that in a bit.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-tal.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-tal.text: You give me what stuff I need to use on da patch and I use it. And hurry up, My Arm gettin' bored.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-tal.player: We should start by raking it.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-tal.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-tal.text: Okieday, you gimme a rake an' My Arm do it.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-giv.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-giv.text: I can't get da goutweed thing in da ground with all these weeds here.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-pla.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-pla.text: Da weedies look healthy enough, t'anks.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-giv.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-giv.text: Da spade not working on dese weedies.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-giv.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-giv.text: I not sure what you want me to do with dat.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-giv.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-giv.text: I not want your bitty bit of paper.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-giv.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-giv.text: I t'ink we already treated da soil.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-giv.player: Oh... there should be more of it than that. Sorry.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-giv.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-giv.text: What you t'ink I want with a stick, huh?

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-giv.player: Oh... there should be more of it than that. Sorry.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-att.text: You reattach the rake head to the handle.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-tal.player: The patch is free from weeds, so we could plant a hardy tuber in it.
Well, I suppose we could treat the soil with compost first.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-tal.text: If My Arm was not given the hardy gout tubers:

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: After dat you probably wanna give me da hardy gout tuber thingies, an' maybe somefing to poke 'em into da soil.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-tal.text: If My Arm was given the hardy gout tubers:

steps.speaker: My Arm
steps.text: Also, I got plenty of da hardy gout tuber thingies, but I gonna need somefing to poke 'em into da soil.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-giv.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-giv.text: Don't I need somefing to plant?

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-farming-items-giv.player: Oh yes, you'll need the gout tubers.

the-rocs-after-my-arm-plants-the-gout-tu.text: My Arm hits the dwarf away.

the-rocs-after-my-arm-plants-the-gout-tu.player: Aww, poor dwarfie. But he's sure to turn up again one of these days - drunken dwarves always keep coming back...

the-rocs-after-my-arm-plants-the-gout-tu.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-after-my-arm-plants-the-gout-tu.text: Uh-oh - I fink da birds noticed us farming...
Baby roc flies to the goutweed.

the-rocs-after-my-arm-plants-the-gout-tu.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-after-my-arm-plants-the-gout-tu.text: It gonna eat da goutweed - kill it, quick!

the-rocs-after-killing-the-baby-roc.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-after-killing-the-baby-roc.text: T'anks for saving da goutweed, [player name]. But I fink dis other birdie not happy with you...

the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-after-defeati.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-after-defeati.text: Ah, lovely goutweed all grown up.

the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-after-defeati.player: Yep, you can harvest it now.
Alright, I think I can arrange a spade for you.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-an-item-other-tha.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-giving-my-arm-an-item-other-tha.text: T'ank you very much for da kind offer, but My Arm not really needin' one of those just now.

the-rocs-attempting-to-pick-the-goutweed.player: I think My Arm should do the honours.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-a-spade.text: As My Arm harvests his crop, you gain Farming XP.
Congratulations! My Arm just advanced a Farming level.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-a-spade.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-giving-my-arm-a-spade.text: T'ank you so much for all da help! Burntmeat gonna be very pleased.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-a-spade.player: I'm just glad the goutweed grew up okay.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-a-spade.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-giving-my-arm-a-spade.text: My Arm just check dis da right stuff...

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-a-spade.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-giving-my-arm-a-spade.text: Yup, dis is goutweed. It lovverley.

the-rocs-giving-my-arm-a-spade.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-giving-my-arm-a-spade.text: You gotta go back to kitchen an' tell Burntmeat da good news. Maybe he give you nice reward for all da hard work you bin doin' for us. But if he not give you anyfing good, you come back an' see My Arm.

the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-again-before-.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-again-before-.text: Did Burntmeat give you nice reward?

the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-again-before-.player: No, I haven't asked him yet.

the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-again-before-.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-again-before-.text: He downstairs in da kitchen. An' if he give you somefing rubbish, come tell My Arm. Maybe I can reward you better.

the-rocs-talking-to-burntmeat.player: We've done it! My Arm's managed to grow some goutweed on the roof of the Stronghold!

the-rocs-talking-to-burntmeat.speaker: Burntmeat
the-rocs-talking-to-burntmeat.text: So now we can grow goutweed whenever we want it?

the-rocs-talking-to-burntmeat.player: Yes, he's got plenty of hardy gout tubers to grow in his little farming patch.

the-rocs-talking-to-burntmeat.speaker: Burntmeat
the-rocs-talking-to-burntmeat.text: T'ank you so much! I dunno what we'd have done if you not come through here to help us.

the-rocs-talking-to-burntmeat.speaker: Burntmeat
the-rocs-talking-to-burntmeat.text: Oh yup, Burntmeat cooked you SPECIAL reward.

the-rocs-talking-to-burntmeat.speaker: Burntmeat
the-rocs-talking-to-burntmeat.text: See, Burntmeat promised you a reward! Anyway, it been nice to see you again, Player. Enjoy your meal.

the-rocs-talking-to-burntmeat-again.speaker: Burntmeat
the-rocs-talking-to-burntmeat-again.text: Burntmeat hope you like your reward. It very special recipe Burntmeat learned when much younger troll.

the-rocs-talking-to-burntmeat-again.prompt: What would you like to say?

options.text: It was very kind of you.

steps.player: Yes, it was very... kind of you.

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Ah, you polite human. Off you go now and see what My Arm want.

options.text: That was the worst reward EVER!

steps.player: That was the worst quest reward EVER! I get better things from killing goblins! I get better things from killing SPIDERS! Why in the world did I ever do a quest for a troll? I could have been training my skills
instead!

steps.text: If the player has completed Gertrude's Cat:

steps.player: I could have trained a cat and got a load of death runes!

steps.text: If the player has played Pest Control:

steps.player: I could have gone back to Pest Control and helped save the universe from hideous monsters!
But no, I did a quest for a troll, and what did I get?
BURNT MEAT! What am I meant to do with burnt meat? I don't WANT burnt meat!

steps.speaker: Burntmeat
steps.text: Human so funny, pretending [he/she] don't like lovely burnt meat! Off you go now and see what My Arm wants.

the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-after-talking.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-after-talking.text: Did Burntmeat give you nice reward?

the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-after-talking.player: No, he jolly well didn't. He gave me burnt meat. Again!

the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-after-talking.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-after-talking.text: Aww, dat a shame. See, Burntmeat like burnt meat. It his favourite thing to cook, an' he do it better than any other troll.

the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-after-talking.player: You said you might be able to give me something better?

the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-after-talking.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-after-talking.text: Yup, an' I will. My Arm gonna tell you big hushy-hushy secret about herbs...
My Arm tells you a secret about herbs.

the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-after-talking.speaker: My Arm
the-rocs-talking-to-my-arm-after-talking.text: Now you know more 'bout herbs. Also, I made a new farming patch like you showed me. Whatever you plant in it, I make sure it don't get disease.
Congratulations, you've completed a quest: My Arm's Big Adventure
